title: Compliance crosswalk: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: HSE leads, management-system owners and auditors
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: The register gives partial evidence for two of the three ISO 45001 clauses shown; the organisation must still show its own records for management review.

items.text: Aid to assurance, not a compliance opinion.

sections.heading: What the learnings show, requirement by requirement

items.lesson: The pump went back into service without a leak test, because no return-to-service step required one.
items.explanation: ISO 45001 clause 8.1 (operational planning and control): the learning shows no return-to-service test for pressure-boundary work. The organisation must still show its own return-to-service procedure and records.

items.lesson: The missing restart checklist was never raised as a corrective action after earlier seal leaks.
items.explanation: ISO 45001 clause 10.2 (incident, nonconformity and corrective action): the learning shows earlier leaks fixed without a corrective action. The organisation must still show how it records and reviews corrective actions.

items.text: One of the three rows carries "(unverified)": its id and title were not checked against the primary text of the standard. Confirm it against the current edition before using the crosswalk in an audit.
